meta.title: UI Restoration Acceptance
meta.description: Close the loop on front-end UI restoration: screenshots, pixel diffs, style probes and a single-file report, with PNG/JPEG design images.

labels.auditHint: Audit mode: see the Probe findings section for style health checks.
labels.specHint: Spec mode: see the Property diffs section for attribute deltas.
labels.noDesign: No-design mode: no design image in this run; self-compare, style probes and the spec baseline decide.
labels.staticSortHint: Tables are pre-sorted by severity and delta at generation time; the page needs no JavaScript.
labels.styleHint: Style metrics are evidence only; they do not take part in the pass/fail decision.
labels.noTimings: No timing recorded for this run
labels.styleBaselineUsed: style reference only; never used for the pixel decision
labels.styleOnlyNote: No design was provided, so only the profile styleBaseline was used for style metrics; there is no pixel decision and no pass verdict.

labels.auditDetail: {elements} elements scanned, overflow {overflow}, missing alt {alt}, focus risks {focus}, suspicious empty states {empty}, inline hard-coded colors {hardcoded}
labels.probeSpec: Spec mode · {total} checks · {passed} passed · {failed} failed (high {high} / medium {medium} / low {low}){misses}
labels.thresholdIgnored: ui_report ignored threshold={declared}: the pass line only comes from the profile (effective={effective}).
labels.auditDisclosure: No design comparison in this audit run; only audit probes ran (ui_probe without expected), so there is no design image or ui-spec to compare against.

fixHints.region: Align this region with the design: layout, spacing, type scale, color or assets.
fixHints.color: Use the design/spec token color instead of the current value.
fixHints.length: Fix the size or spacing; check box model and global scaling.
fixHints.keyword: Fix the layout/display keyword; check overrides and component defaults.
fixHints.shadow: Fix shadow parameters (blur, offset, color, spread).
fixHints.font: Fix the font stack order and ensure the preferred font is loaded.
fixHints.number: Fix the numeric property (weight, opacity, z-index, ...).
fixHints.overflow: Remove horizontal overflow: narrow fixed widths, add min-width: 0 or a wrapping strategy.
fixHints.alt: Add meaningful alt text for the image (alt="" for decorative ones).
fixHints.focus: Add a visible focus style (:focus-visible outline or shadow).
fixHints.empty: Give the empty state an explanation and an action entry point.
fixHints.hardcoded: Move inline hard-coded colors into design tokens.

fixTemplates.regionMoreAction: Check the smaller regions against the region table first; if the diff looks like a global shift, fix the layout root cause instead of nudging blocks.
fixTemplates.issueMoreAction: Work through the probe findings table, highest severity first.
